sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 600. Deals physical damage 5 times that penetrates any nullifying or invulnerability effects with a success value of 100. (Dark).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Lethargy for 40 seconds with a success value of 100.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Erosion (nullifies effects that penetrate nullifying or invulnerability effects when using an attack Ability) for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases physical and magic attack Ability Power by 100 for 120 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Boosts critical hit Ability Power by 100 for 120 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases physical and magic Ability Power and Critical Assault buff limits by 50 for 120 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies Rage for 120 seconds (increases max HP, ATK, and MATK by 100%; nullifies status ailments and Cost reduction. When in effect, recovers 30% of your character's max HP, recovers 30 Cost, and removes debuffs/special debuffs when you defeat an enemy).
-Target: yourself. Applies Redoubt for 120 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] reduces physical/magic damage by 50%; nullifies fixed damage; nullifies special status ailments; nullifies status ailments. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
Increases physical and magic Ability Power by 50 when equipped in the Main Slot.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 40000
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Reduces physical/magic damage taken to 0 (7 times). Effect applied for 120 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 40000
